rawContent: "While most of the vitriol is nominally directed at Heard, it is hard to shake the feeling that really, it is directed at all women ... at those of us who spoke out about gendered abuse & sexual violence during the height of the #MeToo movement. https://t.co/GO2uf0k1Rc

“This isn’t a political issue – this is an issue of true humanity in the workplace. It’s real and happening to both men and women. Both parties have an interest in this."
